rules.title: The cited literature sets the floor; a strong referee's admiration sets the target
rules.failure: Drafts were judged against our own earlier drafts, so a pass that removed the worst tics read as success while the prose stayed below the papers it cites.
rules.rule: Before revising, choose three or more papers the manuscript itself cites, closest to it in genre, and learn how they open, announce results, credit prior work, narrate proofs, introduce notation, organise sections and state limits. Write with those moves. Their register is the minimum; the aim is prose a strong referee in the field would single out as better written than the source it explains. Imitate moves, never text, and never imitate a named author's voice.
rules.limit: Some features of a paper about a formal proof have no analogue in the literature (a verification paragraph, links to declarations); for those, follow the closest practice the literature has and say that it is a judgement.

rules.failure: Revision rounds fixed located findings and left the surrounding sentences as they were, so prose quality never improved faster than the findings list.
rules.rule: Each revision round, whether after drafting or after a critique, reads every paragraph in order and records three things for it: what the paragraph is for, what is weak in it, and the rewrite. rules.limit: The line edit changes prose only. Mathematics, hypotheses, quantifiers, citations and attribution stay fixed; a weakness in them returns to the earlier transition.

example.before:
We prove irrationality of $\sum_{a\in A}(b^a-1)^{-1}$ for every integer
$b\ge2$ under two conditions on the support: a weighted summability
condition and a summable positive divisor cover. Both allow divergent
reciprocal sums and pass to infinite subsets. A finite average over
multiples, followed by an average over dyadic lengths, combines the
conditions and admits supports satisfying neither one separately.
example.after:

multiples and then over dyadic lengths places both estimates on a common finite
distribution, so the conditions can be combined. The resulting class contains supports
in neither individual class. Irrationality for arbitrary infinite support
in base two remains open.
